# Sidebar

The desktop sidebar with the brand, the always-visible live mini-gauge and connection status, the six sections, the running timer, and the account.

`CLR.Sidebar` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.Sidebar active="now" load={…} context="deep_focus" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.Sidebar" active="now" load="{{…}}" context="deep_focus"></x-import>
```

## Props (SidebarProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `active` * | `"now" \| "focus" \| "tasks" \| "history" \| "insights" \| "settings"` |  |
| `load` * | `number \| null` |  |
| `context` * | `"deep_focus" \| "shallow_work" \| "stuck" \| "fatigue" \| "recovering" \| "unknown"` |  |
| `confidence` * | `number` |  |
| `status` * | `'live' \| 'reconnecting' \| 'offline'` |  |
| `timer` | `Pick<MiniPlayerProps, 'phase' \| 'remainingSeconds' \| 'totalSeconds'>` | Running timer, shown as a compact row above the account. |
| `collapsed` | `boolean` | 72px icon rail at 1024–1279px. |
| `onNavigate` * | `(route: Route) => void` |  |
